defects.rootCause: QA strict schema permitted generic evidence strings while the authoritative finding guard requires its evidence subset; live denial proves at least one globally valid unrelated reference, exact ID not retained.
defects.detectionGap: Prior cardinality tests pinned finding ID/count but did not test narrower finding evidence against other approved context evidence.
defects.regression: Six new finding-evidence and closed diagnostic cases plus realistic full five-stage fixture sizes, historical compact identity and native workflow/cleanup tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Derive schema directly from the same validated prior finding used by the authoritative semantic guard; do not broaden permissions or rewrite rejected output.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing schema/instructions/error boundary only. No new orchestration, reviewer, gateway, credentials, journal or spending policy.
proactiveReview.threats: Cross-finding citations, false acceptance, malformed prior evidence and raw diagnostic leakage.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Unsupported prior evidence fails before request; invalid current output fails schema; generic semantic denial preserves useful closed path.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Known-but-unrelated citations, missing/empty/unknown/duplicate prior evidence, allowed rejection, schema mismatch metadata and all native stage failure/cleanup paths.
